description: The backups of the data Neblla keeps for an app: the copies of the last 7 days (30 with Pro; `keepDays` says which), taken from Neblla's daily encrypted copy of its databases, and restoring one whole. Actions: "list" (enabled: whether Neblla keeps copies at all; envs.pro / envs.pre: byodb, usesProData, the last restore; days: [{ date, createdAt, pro, pre }] with how many rows of each kind the copy holds — players, saves, tables, inbox, community, chat, rooms, purchases, customers; null with the developer's own database, which Neblla does not copy); "restore" (date, env "pro" by default or "pre": EVERYTHING of that environment goes back to that day — saves, tables, inbox, community, chat, rooms; players who are still there get their row of that day, who arrived since keeps theirs with no data, who was erased since does not come back; purchases and Stripe customers are never changed, only missing ones come back. Irreversible: confirm with the developer first. The app is locked a few seconds like a database migration (players hear neblla.app.on('maintenance') and reconnect), and it is paid from the app's quota like one (reads, writes and bytes, kind "migration"); past the quota it fails with quota_exceeded and resumesAt. It runs in the background: poll "status"); "status" (env: running | done | failed | interrupted, restored per kind, erasedSince, cost). Errors: byodb, backups_off, no_such_backup, migrating, already_restoring, archived.

date.description: For restore: the day of the copy, YYYY-MM-DD, one of list's days

env.description: For restore and status: "pro" (default, the published app) or its "pre"

name: neblla_backups
